reviews.text: I ordered a specific betta fish and received one that looked nothing like the photos and was in terrible condition. To make matters worse, they haven't taken any responsibility whatsoever after I contacted them by email and sent them photos. I've attached a photo comparing what I received to what I ordered. While it's not always exactly what I see and I receive something approximate, this is nothing like what I expected.
Thank you for the five stars, Basia. We're glad to have your feedback on Nascapers.

I've shopped at this store several times, about four or five times now, and I've always been very satisfied. The service is excellent, shipping is very fast, and the quality of the fish is very good. It's definitely my first choice in Valencia. 100% recommended!
The service was good, although one of the staff members needs to improve his customer service skills. When you visit a place like this, you expect to be given guidance.

Very bad experience. I placed two orders. The first one contained dead fish, and I received a discount coupon. The second order didn't include the plants, even though I sent an unboxing video. The shipping company's system is inadequate. I lost my money and the plants never arrived.
Advanced aquarium shop. Specialists in aquascapes and creating natural-looking aquariums. They don't have a huge variety of fish. For aquascapes, they're one of the best in the city.

Hello, I don't understand how anyone can give this store a positive review.
In the last two weeks, I've been there twice, and both times I wasn't served; I was completely ignored.
I understand that everyone has a bad day, but this happened twice. Well, those who were served politely and professionally were lucky.

Choosing this store to buy my first orandas was a truly wonderful decision. The fish arrived in perfect condition, and they are truly magnificent specimens. They very kindly answered my question via email. The order took a week to arrive, which is understandable considering the holidays and the delicate procedures required to ship live animals to ensure their well-being. I reiterate my excellent experience with this establishment.
The place is nice and the aquariums are very pretty, especially the one with grey stones, but the prices are a bit high.
Everything arrives well cared for and in perfect condition, 100 out of 10.

I've placed two orders and everything was great. I'd like to highlight the quality of the products and the speed of delivery.
Thank you so much for everything, keep up the good work!

I'm spending a few days in Valencia visiting family and I couldn't miss a visit to this aquarium shop. Personalized customer service, without overcrowding the store. Angel helped us, answering all our questions and giving us great advice. A really good vibe, everything was super clean and beautiful. I could live there!
The place is practically a museum for aquarium enthusiasts, especially those who love planted aquariums. It's an ADA-certified retailer and has a huge variety of products.

A terrible experience. They sent us a fish that was sick, and it died two weeks later (today). The owner can say whatever he wants, but my aquarium had been undergoing treatment for a whole month, had completed its cycle successfully, and everything was ready to give a new life to what was going to be my son's fish. But no, from practically the beginning, it never behaved like a well-adapted betta: it stayed still for many hours, initially almost always at the surface, ate very little, barely explored, and later started spending a lot of time resting on plants and finally at the bottom, where it never recovered. We bought the most expensive betta available, and the poor thing arrived in terrible condition. Yes, what's sold online isn't always the same as what you receive, but there's a difference between that and what I got. Poor thing... you guys are awful.

Hello Fernando, thank you for taking the time to rate NAscapers five stars.

We're delighted to hear that your experience with us has been positive and that you trust our work for your aquarium projects.
We will continue striving to always offer you the best materials and technical advice.

If you need any further assistance in the future, we are available both in-store and by email.

I bought some guppies online and they arrived looking beautiful, very healthy, and in great condition, so I'm happy about that.

However, the customer service left much to be desired. I went to the store to ask if the fish had arrived, and the response was very rude, saying that "everything is explained on the website," even though the website is not at all user-friendly and the information isn't easy to find.

Furthermore, the order was delayed by a day, and no one replied to the email I sent asking why, nor did they offer any explanation for the delay.

It's a shame, because the product is good, but the customer service experience was quite poor.

I definitely won't be buying from them again.
My experience with this store was awful.
We bought a fan and some snails.
They charged me €9.90 for shipping, so I'm paying for a service that supposedly delivers the package before 4 pm.
I had to call MRW (the courier service) and they told me it was a standard 3-day delivery.
Besides, I spent two days trying to contact them and they didn't answer the phone or social media like Instagram.
You shouldn't just use social media to show photos or videos or be an influencer, but also to provide customer service. As for the snails, let's not even go there; as expected, they didn't arrive alive, and it's clear, as stated on their website, that they aren't responsible.
I hope my experience with this store helps others.
Excellent service

Very disappointed. The first order was fine. But for the second, I ordered a Bucephalandra bridge (equivalent to two tubs) and they sent me a log with three Bucephalandra plants glued on. Today I received my third order, and the Foxtail plant in tubs with stems about 3 cm long was damaged and rotten. I'm sorry, but I won't be ordering again.

A very good experience. The service was excellent and professional; they answered all our questions and were always willing to help.

The animals looked to be in very good condition, which is essential for me in an aquarium shop. It's clear they take good care of the aquariums and the animals.

Overall, excellent service and helpful advice. I would definitely return. 🐠👍

Terrible experience! They waste your time, hiding behind the excuse of having too many orders (poor company logistics). Customers shouldn't have to pay for their mismanagement, and then they send you a different version of what you ordered. They have a page with a description and don't even bother to inform you that they don't have the product, sending you what they do have in a different format. Not to mention the state of the other plant, which shouldn't even be for sale. There's absolutely no shame in this.

Very professional. Also, the aquariums are spotless, which inspires confidence. The only downside is that they should remove the tannins from the Forest tank, as they did previously with the Amazon. But that's a matter of personal preference.
Thank you for your kindness, everything is fine ❤️😘🤗 …

The fish shipment was fantastic. It arrived overnight and was perfectly protected and prepared. There was also a minor stock issue, which they resolved in the best way possible for the customer. Thank you so much, you're my new supplier.
has a couple of Amazonian molli
The best and most well-maintained shop in the region

Today I received some new killifish and shrimp, they're fantastic!
The order arrived very quickly and in a double bag. Plus, they included free food for a week.
This has been my go-to shop for three years, and I hope they open a store in Zaragoza someday.
The shop has a great atmosphere, the fish look healthy and their aquariums are very well maintained, the staff are super friendly and the prices are good. In short, I highly recommend it!

I always order online, and my experience with NAscapers has been excellent. The fish always arrive in great health, with vibrant colors, and in perfect condition. Plus, the shipping is fast and the packages are very well prepared.
I recently visited the store for the first time. Although I live in Huesca, which is quite far, it was totally worth the trip. I loved the store, and the service I received was excellent. I will definitely continue to rely on them for my aquariums. Highly recommended!
It's been a long, long time since I've seen such a well-prepared store...excellent service and knowledge...I highly recommend it.

A very good experience. We bought our betta fish here and we're delighted. The fish is beautiful and it's clear they take very good care of it. The owner's advice was excellent; he explained everything to us very patiently and helped us choose the best things to get started with the aquarium. It's so nice to find a specialized shop where they really know about fish and care about them. Highly recommended.

Hello Maria Camila, thank you for taking the time to leave this review. We're happy to confirm that your experience with NAscapers has been positive. We work daily to offer the best service and advice in aquascaping. We're here to help you with any projects or questions about your aquariums. We hope to see you soon in our store or on our website.
They do everything perfectly: answering questions, shipping, perfect products...unbeatable.
Quality, speed and above all good service

Hello, thank you so much for taking a moment to leave us your five-star review.

We're delighted to confirm that your experience with NAscapers has been positive.

We put all our effort into offering quality materials and the best advice for your aquascaping projects.

We remain at your disposal through our usual channels to help you with your aquarium in the future.
Everything was perfect, the order arrived at my home within 24 hours. I ordered some aquarium plants, and they were absolutely perfect.

Hello Dorde, thank you for taking the time to rate your experience with NAscapers.

We are pleased to confirm that our service has met your expectations. Your support helps us continue working to offer the best technical expertise and customer service in aquascaping.
We are available in-store or via email to assist you with your future projects and answer any questions you may have about aquariums.
Thank you very much, Pedro!

Hello Consuelo, thank you for taking the time to share this review.

We are delighted to confirm that your experience with NAscapers has been so positive.
We take great care in selecting plants and aquascaping materials to offer a high level of quality.

If you need technical advice for maintaining your aquarium, please write to us at luis@nascapers.es or visit our store.
We are at your complete disposal to help you with your future projects.
Great service and the store is amazing

Thank you for your positive review and for taking the time to read our product. We're delighted to hear you had a great experience with us and that you gave us the highest rating. We work every day to offer the best products and technical advice in the world of aquascaping. We remain at your disposal for any future projects or needs you may have.
Excellent
Hi everyone, I just received my order, and I'm very happy with everything, from the fast delivery and the packaging to the size of the fish. Everything is great, thank you!

I will never shop online again. Due to a misunderstanding on the website regarding shipping, I ordered four fish for a pond I have at another address about 200 km away. I wanted to cancel the order because they wouldn't arrive that week when I was going to go. They told me I couldn't cancel the order, absolutely not. I asked them to send them the following week, which was this week. Their shipping policy is that they should arrive on Wednesday, Thursday at the latest, Friday. Imagine my surprise when the fish arrived today, Wednesday! Fish in bags until Friday morning? No way! So they really need to rethink their online shipping policy. The funniest thing is that they send you documents saying they won't arrive until Thursday or Friday.

Visiting the store after watching it so many times on their YouTube channel, I liked it even more in person. Everything is on display, full of ideas to dream about and make you envious. Congratulations on how beautiful the store is!

I'm so happy with the arrival of these two female bettas, they couldn't have been more beautiful! Thank you so much, nascapers, for your constant help and for these gorgeous specimens. A great shop with a fantastic YouTube channel, I love it!

This is my first purchase from this store, and it was a great experience.

The fish arrived in perfect condition, very healthy, a good size, and they're beautiful.

The plants also arrived in good condition, but I think they're quite small for the price. Perhaps they could consider adjusting the price or making them a bit larger.

Even so, I'm sure I'll be back in the future!

Since I'm not from Valencia, I order online. The fish always arrive perfectly packaged and in good condition.
Thanks, Luis, for the great service and quick answers to my questions. Don't change! 🫶🏻 …

We ordered some snails online and one arrived hollow, just the shell. To top it off, they refuse to take responsibility. I won't buy from this store again. Given the price, I won't take further action, but I want to document their behavior.

The best aquarium shop in Spain. They have impeccable taste in aquarium decoration and display. They have a YouTube channel where you can learn a great deal. It's a shame they're not located in my area. Home deliveries arrive incredibly fast and in excellent condition. You can always contact them via email. I will definitely order fish and products from them again.
Beautiful

Thank you so much for your positive review and for trusting NAscapers. We're delighted to hear that your experience with us was satisfactory, as we work daily to offer the highest quality in our aquascaping products and services.
We greatly appreciate you sharing your rating with the rest of the community. We remain at your disposal for anything you may need in the future.
Delighted
Thank you so much, Ismael!

Excellent experience at Nascapers! ⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐
From the very first moment, I received wonderful service in the world of aquariums. The team took all the time in the world to explain everything I needed to know about aquariums, fish, setup, filtration, plants, and specific care in detail, without rushing and with incredible patience. I felt very comfortable and well taken care of, as if I were chatting with passionate friends who really know their stuff and care about helping you get off to a good start.

The atmosphere is super friendly and welcoming, and you can tell they are passionate about the aquarium hobby. I will definitely return to Nascapers and I recommend it to anyone who wants to get started in aquariums or improve their setup: a place where you are treated with care, professionalism, and total dedication! Thank you so much for making entering this world so enjoyable and easy. 🐠🌿
Nascapers is undoubtedly one of the best stores in the country! They are incredibly professional and resolve any questions or problems quickly! I recommend them 100% and best of luck! 💪🏼 …

It's a really special place, even for those new to aquariums. It's wonderful. The staff is also incredibly friendly and helpful, even if your aquarium is basic and not one of the amazing ones you see there. We found some beautiful natural rocks at a reasonable price, as well as some plants, and we bought some small fish that were compatible with the ones we already had. The result has been truly incredible. Many thanks to the NAscapers team.

This shop is beautiful. The aquariums are a sight to behold. It's wonderful for everyone, from beginners to those new to the aquarium hobby. Very easily accessible from the Ayora metro stop, Maritim line.
Amazing, incredibly fast service! I placed an order yesterday afternoon and had it in my hands before lunch today. Fantastic! Thank you!
Super professional service and absolute empathy with the client/friend. Without a doubt, the best aquarium team in Valencia.

Great aquarist shop, they have a very large variety of aquarium plants, freshwater fish, shrimps, decorations, etc.
Not the cheapest though, prices might be on the higher end compared to some other shops.
Its possible to park right in front.
I've bought fish online twice and it's been great. The second time they didn't have one of the fish I ordered, but they sent it the following week at no extra cost. Very good shop.

I wanted to thank you for the advice Angel gave me on setting up the aquarium. It was very helpful. I also watched several videos on your YouTube channel, and they were a great help in clarifying some doubts I had. I'm very happy with the result.

I'm a beginner and I'm setting up my first small aquarium. I was quite lost with so much information online, but Nascapers has helped me get the project off the ground. Their advice is top-notch: they recommend exactly what you need, and it's clear they want your aquarium to thrive, not just to make a sale. The plants arrived in perfect condition, and the equipment is of superior quality. It's such a relief to find professionals who give you that kind of confidence when you're starting out. Highly recommended!
Thank you so much!

Excellent fish and other aquarium inhabitants, but you need to order the desired fish in advance, as they are not available in the store. I came to pick up some Pseudomugils and was told they were out of stock and needed to order them in advance. This is a minor drawback.

Excellent professionals, very friendly, attentive, and dedicated staff. Their animals are superb, in perfect health and with vibrant coloring. This will definitely be my go-to pet shop. Thank you so much for your work, Nscapers team!
I've been a customer for two years and I still think that the day I walked through that door was the best decision for my hobby. I'm happier every day.
The advice and the experience of visiting such a beautiful shop have been wonderful.

I've bought things here many times now, initially botanicals, then fertilizers, an external filter, and a fish here and there. I say this because it's become a pleasant experience, practically a routine. I've always just stopped by to buy something I wanted with a clear idea of ​​what I needed, and that's it. But I'm writing this review because the last time I was a bit lost on how to plant my hardscape, and when I went back after several months to get some plants, I was surprised when they remembered my name without me even saying anything. And then, with the advice and the plants they sold me, I couldn't be happier with the result.
